title: Heirloom Brooch
description: Once per combat, after you play a Power, gain 5 Block.
flavor: An old clasp, polished by many hands.
baseline: Modest delayed defense; Anchor grants 10 Block at combat start.

title: Training Dummy
description: The first time each turn an Attack leaves you with Block, gain 1 Vigor for your next Attack.
flavor: The family insisted on learning to guard before striking.
baseline: One Vigor per turn after a guarded Attack; it applies to every hit of the next Attack. Vajra grants 1 Strength to every Attack without this condition.

title: Threadbound Ledger
description: The first time you Exhaust a card during your turn, draw 1 card.
flavor: Even a discarded lesson deserves a place in the record.
baseline: One draw per turn, compared with Dark Embrace drawing for every Exhaust.

title: Wayfarer Ribbon
description: The first time you discard a card during your turn, gain 3 Block. End-of-turn discards do not count.
flavor: Tie it to the path you mean to return by.
baseline: Capped at 3 Block per turn; Tough Bandages grants 3 for every manual discard.

title: Triune Crest
description: Once per combat: Knight gains 4 Block after a Skill; Mage gains 1 Arcane Charge after a Skill (maximum 2); Ranger gains 3 Vigor after an Attack.
baseline: A small one-use class resource; no permanent stat or crown multiplier.

title: Legacy Hourglass
description: At the start of turn 3, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card. Once per combat.
flavor: The next heir will inherit the time you leave behind.
baseline: A delayed one-use burst; Pocketwatch can draw 3 each qualifying turn.

title: Family Seal
description: Once each turn, after you have played an Attack, a Skill and a Power, gain 4 Block and draw 1 card.
flavor: Not all branches look alike. They still share the same roots.
baseline: Three distinct types required; Ornamental Fan grants 4 Block per three Attacks and Letter Opener deals 5 to all per three Skills.

title: Guardian Knot
description: Once per combat, after you play an Attack while you have Block, gain 3 Block.
flavor: A cord tied around a lesson the family means to keep.
baseline: Only 3 Block once per combat after an Attack with existing Block; Anchor grants 10 immediately.

title: Scholar Bookmark
description: Once per combat, after you play a Power, draw 1 card.
flavor: A feather left in the margin where the next question begins.
baseline: One draw per combat after paying for a Power; no energy refund or unlimited draw loop.

title: Trail Compass
description: At the start of turn 2, gain 3 Vigor. Once per combat.
flavor: It points toward a chance, never a promise.
baseline: One delayed +3 damage bonus to the next Attack, including its hits; not permanent Strength.
